		<div class="entry-content alignfull wp-block-post-content has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-block-post-content-is-layout-constrained"><h1>Debug fixture hub</h1>
<p>This local site hosts the deterministic worst cases a front-end debugging tool has to catch. Scenarios attach to any page through URL flags and need no site configuration:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=reference">?fdt-error=reference</a> — ReferenceError at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=reading">?fdt-error=reading</a> — reading of undefined at load</li>

<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=minified">?fdt-error=minified</a> — one-letter ReferenceError (the minified-name shape)</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-delay=1">?fdt-delay=1</a> — Delay JS queue (interact with the page to run it)</li>
</ul>
<p>The image below is an in-page LCP candidate for Lazyload and critical-image runs.</p>

		<div class="entry-content alignfull wp-block-post-content has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-block-post-content-is-layout-constrained"><h1>Debug fixture hub</h1>
<p>This local site hosts the deterministic worst cases a front-end debugging tool has to catch. Scenarios attach to any page through URL flags and need no site configuration:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=reference">?fdt-error=reference</a> — ReferenceError at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=reading">?fdt-error=reading</a> — reading of undefined at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=notfunction">?fdt-error=notfunction</a> — not a function at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=minified">?fdt-error=minified</a> — one-letter ReferenceError (the minified-name shape)</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-delay=1">?fdt-delay=1</a> — Delay JS queue (interact with the page to run it)</li>
</ul>
<p>The image below is an in-page LCP candidate for Lazyload and critical-image runs.</p>
<p><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20320%20180'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Independent LCP candidate" width="320" height="180" data-lazy-src="/wp-content/mu-plugins/assets/fdt-lcp.png"><noscript><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" src="/wp-content/mu-plugins/assets/fdt-lcp.png" alt="Independent LCP candidate" width="320" height="180"></noscript></p>
<p>Pages here are cached like any real site; a cache purge never changes scenario behavior because fixtures are code, not admin state.</p>

		<div class="entry-content alignfull wp-block-post-content has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-block-post-content-is-layout-constrained"><h1>Debug fixture hub</h1>
<p>This local site hosts the deterministic worst cases a front-end debugging tool has to catch. Scenarios attach to any page through URL flags and need no site configuration:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=reference">?fdt-error=reference</a> — ReferenceError at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=reading">?fdt-error=reading</a> — reading of undefined at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=notfunction">?fdt-error=notfunction</a> — not a function at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=minified">?fdt-error=minified</a> — one-letter ReferenceError (the minified-name shape)</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-delay=1">?fdt-delay=1</a> — Delay JS queue (interact with the page to run it)</li>
</ul>
<p>The image below is an in-page LCP candidate for Lazyload and critical-image runs.</p>
<p><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20320%20180'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Independent LCP candidate" width="320" height="180" data-lazy-src="/wp-content/mu-plugins/assets/fdt-lcp.png"><noscript><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" src="/wp-content/mu-plugins/assets/fdt-lcp.png" alt="Independent LCP candidate" width="320" height="180"></noscript></p>
<p>Pages here are cached like any real site; a cache purge never changes scenario behavior because fixtures are code, not admin state.</p>

		<h1 class="wp-block-post-title">Debug fixture hub</h1>
		<div class="entry-content alignfull wp-block-post-content has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-block-post-content-is-layout-constrained"><h1>Debug fixture hub</h1>
<p>This local site hosts the deterministic worst cases a front-end debugging tool has to catch. Scenarios attach to any page through URL flags and need no site configuration:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=reference">?fdt-error=reference</a> — ReferenceError at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=reading">?fdt-error=reading</a> — reading of undefined at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=notfunction">?fdt-error=notfunction</a> — not a function at load</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-error=minified">?fdt-error=minified</a> — one-letter ReferenceError (the minified-name shape)</li>
<li><a href="/fdt/?fdt-delay=1">?fdt-delay=1</a> — Delay JS queue (interact with the page to run it)</li>
